title: Substrate Self-Similarity Fixed Point
statement: The substrate W(3,3) is the unique fixed point of the exceptional-Lie functor F: Graph -> (|Aut|, |V|, |E|, chi_line). F(W(3,3)) = (51840, 40, 240, 160). |Aut(W(3,3))| = 51840 = |W(E_6)|, the Weyl group of E_6. The E_6 root system has 72 = lambda_gauge roots. The E_6 Dynkin diagram has rank 6 = q!. The E_6 root poset longest chain has 36 = v/2 + k/2 - 2 levels. W(3,3) -> E_6 -> W(3,3) is a closed loop under (Aut order <-> Weyl group <-> root count <-> substrate primitives).
closed_loop: E_6 rank = 6 = q! -> substrate Master Equation root
law: W(3,3) is the unique fixed point of the exceptional-Lie functor: its automorphism order identifies E_6's Weyl group, whose invariants (root count = lambda_gauge, rank = q!, chain = v/2+k/2-2) all re-identify the substrate. The substrate is self-referentially closed under exceptional symmetry.
